step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home button () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work > Fields. The list of fields inserted in the template is displayed.

note.p: You can identify the read-only field by a lock icon () displayed corresponding to the field name. To know more about read-only clauses, see Making Fields Read Only in a Template.

step.cmd: Click on a field name in the list. The document scrolls to highlight the selected field in the template.
